\begin{table*}[t]
\caption{Recall@20 and NDCG@20 of multimodal recommenders under the common training protocol. Every compared model uses its author-derived configuration, to which MSCA + MES adds MES. Each cell reports the mean over seeds 1--5 with the standard deviation over seeds. In each column, the best mean over seeds among the unfused rows is in bold. $^{\blacktriangledown}$/$^{\blacktriangle}$: significantly lower/higher than MSCA + MES (two-sided paired $t$-test over seeds 1--5, Holm correction over the datasets of each contrast, $p<0.05$). The last block adds the same training-free fusion of RP3$\beta$ and ItemKNN-CBF scores (F) to every model, with the fusion weight selected on validation recall for each seed; its rows carry no bold, and no model is claimed to rank first after fusion. Its last four rows fuse the validation mix of RP3$\beta$, ItemKNN-CBF, ItemKNN-CF, and EASE instead, and give the margin of MSCA + MES over MSCA after F and after the mix. The two margin rows ($^{\dagger}$) use seeds 1--10 of the preregistered ten-seed extension of the fusion run set, whereas the other rows average seeds 1--5, and they are marked when significant with Holm correction over the four datasets of this table, where the marks in the NDCG@20 columns are post hoc. A number in parentheses in this block gives the number of seeds that passed the re-evaluation gate, and such a cell shows the mean over these seeds without a standard deviation. Missing seeds in the fused block failed the re-evaluation gate because of stochastic evaluation (LGMRec Gumbel sampling, COHESION graph padding). The fused MSCA rows come from the five-seed fusion run set of MSCA, which shares the checkpoints of the rows above on Sports alone, since only seed 1 of these checkpoints is stored on Baby, Pantry, and Scientific (Section~\ref{sec:settings}). On Baby, MSCA, MSCA + MES, and the unfused COHESION row read the canonical build of the item kNN cache, the other rows of SMORE, PGL, FREEDOM, and COHESION read its second build, and DiffMM and LGMRec read neither (supplementary Table~\ref{tab:babybuild}). Table~\ref{tab:fuse_added} reports the fusion on five further datasets.}
